title: Answer: report, subjective ratings and metacognition, against matched performance

statements.text: Consciousness is observed through sincere report, which expresses the higher-order thought, and through subjective ratings and confidence, compared on each trial with task performance. Subjective and objective measures dissociate, and only the subjective ones bear directly on awareness.

sources.quote: the distinction between subjective and objective measures is central to the scientific study of consciousness
The purpose of these ratings is to indicate whether a relevant stimulus property has been consciously perceived
